subject: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@omegacloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Quick recap and next step: OmegaCloud confirmed the 18-month renewal term and the expansion to add two additional Dedicated GPU pools (estimated 120K monthly tokens). Legal asked us to reconcile the MSA updates with the attached Order Form and a small addendum for the burst capacity.

Attached: initial redline set from your team (we received v3), and our latest OrderForm draft.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Can your team confirm the target effective date (you mentioned July 1) and whether Procurement needs a PO number before signature?
- We propose tightening the SLA credit calc in Section 4.2 of the MSA to preserve the existing credit cap; legal will propose language below.
- We need to align on the data retention / audit log window for Dedicated customers (our default is 90 days but we can extend for an enterprise tier if needed).

I'll loop in Olga from Legal to walk through the redlines and propose a short marked-up summary. Can we aim for a signed package by June 10 so we can hit the July onboard?

Cheers,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments (stubs): OmegaCloud_Renewal_Redlines_v3.docx (changes tracked), OrderForm_OmegaCloud_2027-06.xlsx (price schedule)

From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@omegacloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Chang <tim.chang@omegacloud.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@omegacloud.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)

Dylan —

Appreciate the recap. Confirming: OmegaCloud is committed to the 18-month term starting July 1. Procurement would prefer to have a PO before countersignature; PO issuance targeted week of June 14 (we can fast-track if legal review finishes sooner).

Two quick notes on the redlines we sent:
1) We removed the automatic rollback clause for burst capacity — we need explicit notice and 30 days to review usage before any rollback.
2) We proposed a 180-day audit log retention for regulatory reasons.

I've attached v3 with comments. Tim from our engineering team is on copy to help with technical acceptance criteria for the Dedicated pools.

Samantha
Director, Cloud Platform | OmegaCloud
---
Attachments (stubs): OmegaCloud_Renewal_Redlines_v3.docx (S. Lewis comments)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)

Team —

I reviewed OmegaCloud's v3. Summary of material items and our proposed positions: 

- Term & Effective Date: Accept July 1 effective date. We will include execution confirmation language to handle PO timing ("effective upon mutual execution or receipt of PO, not to exceed 30 days").

- Burst capacity rollback: Counterparty deleted auto-rollback. We should accept a notice-first model but keep the ability to throttle for abuse. Proposed clause: 30 day notice + operational remediation period; immediate throttling allowed only with documented abuse and 24-hour notice except where safety of platform is at risk.

- Audit logs/data retention: Omega requests 180 days. Our standard is 90 days. We can offer 180 days for Enterprise Dedicated customers as a priced add-on (referenced in Order Form line item). Request engineering to confirm storage delta.

- SLA credit calculation: Their edits reduce the credit cap; we should preserve the existing cap but accept a narrowed credit window if they take longer escalation steps. Draft language attached (Rollover_Addendum_OmegaCloud.pdf).

Action items for internal ops/legal:
1) Grace: confirm cost delta for 180-day retention and the incremental storage line item for the OrderForm.
2) Marissa: run the revised OrderForm through procurement path and identify signature role (we need the PO flow documented).
3) Dylan: coordinate updated redline (we'll produce a tracked changes package for Samantha).

I recommend a quick 30-minute redline call with Omega legal to resolve the burst + retention items next week.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments (stubs): Rollover_Addendum_OmegaCloud.pdf (proposed SLA language)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)

All —

Confirmed on costs: 180-day retention adds ~$6,200/month (storage + retention ops) for the Dedicated setup Omega described. I've added an OrderForm line item: "Extended Audit Retention (180d) — Monthly fee" and included quant math in the attached pricing sheet. Marissa — happy to sync on PO flow; list of approvals below can be included in the procurement memo.

Approvals needed (suggested path):
- Procurement (Omega): PO issuance to Redwood
- Redwood: RevOps sign-off -> Legal -> CFO countersign for revenue recognition timing

I'll join the redline call and bring the pricing worksheet.

—Grace
Sr. RevOps Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments (stubs): OrderForm_OmegaCloud_2027-06.xlsx (pricing worksheet)

From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@omegacloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Chang <tim.chang@omegacloud.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@omegacloud.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract dovetail: renewal + expansion redlines (OmegaCloud)

Thanks, Olga and Grace — helpful summary.

We can accept the execution language tying effective date to PO receipt (30-day cap). Procurement expects the priced add-on for 180-day retention to be a separate line item on the Order Form — that works. On burst throttling, we'll take your notice-first model to legal but expect a firm ops SLA for remediation steps; Tim will send a short matrix of acceptance tests for the Dedicated pools by tomorrow.

Let's schedule the 30-minute redline call on Monday (June 7) — available 10:00–11:00 PDT. If that time works, we'll send a calendar invite and draft an agreed agenda: SLA credits, burst handling, audit retention pricing, signature flow.

Samantha
Director, Cloud Platform | OmegaCloud
---
Attachments (none)
thread_notes: Internal thread: sales-led renewal + expansion. Final planned redline call scheduled; next steps: produce tracked changes, confirm PO timing, add priced retention line item to OrderForm.
